title: Polling scenario shows no executions for hours but is still running
symptoms: History shows no runs for hours on a scenario that polls every 15 minutes
cause: Make does not write an execution to history when a polling trigger runs and finds zero new items. A quiet trigger and a dead trigger look identical in the history view.
fix: Judge liveness from nextExec, not from gaps in history. A healthy poller has nextExec in the future and it moves forward one interval after each poll.
apply: GET /api/v2/scenarios/{id} and compare nextExec with the current time; check again after one interval and confirm it advanced.
affected: Make, polling triggers, August to October 2026
